about.headline: Cleaning done right, every single time.
about.intro: Fifo Städfirma was founded in Stockholm in 2013 by a family that believed a clean space should be something everyone could rely on — not a luxury. Over a decade later, we still run every booking the same way: show up, do the job properly, and leave the space better than we found it.
about.storyBody1: We started with a single van and three clients in Södermalm. Word spread quickly — not because we marketed aggressively, but because we kept every promise we made. By 2016 we had expanded to Göteborg. By 2019, Malmö. Today our teams cover four cities and over 2 000 completed bookings.
about.storyBody2: We are still family-run. Every cleaner on our team is vetted, trained in-house, and fully insured. We don't use subcontractors. When you book with Fifo, the same people turn up every time.
about.missionBody1: To make professional cleaning genuinely accessible — with honest pricing, consistent quality, and the kind of service you'd recommend to your mother.
about.missionBody2: We use certified eco-friendly products across all our services. Not because it's trendy, but because it's better for your family, your colleagues, and the environment we all share.

reliability.title: Reliability
reliability.body: We show up on time, every time. If something isn't right, we come back and fix it — free of charge.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.body: You see exactly what you pay for before we start. No surprise charges, no hidden fees.

thoroughness.title: Thoroughness
thoroughness.body: We don't cut corners. Every booking follows our standard checklist, verified before we leave.

respect.title: Respect
respect.body: We treat your home or office as if it were our own — with care, discretion, and attention to detail.

services.headline: Our Services
services.intro: Every service is carried out by insured, trained cleaners using certified eco-friendly products. Prices are fixed — you get a detailed quote before any work begins.

house.title: House Cleaning
house.description: Recurring maintenance cleaning for apartments and houses of any size. We clean kitchens, bathrooms, living areas and bedrooms to a consistent standard every visit. Choose weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly — we adapt to your schedule.
includes: Clean kitchen surfaces, hob, and sink
house.note: Ideal for: busy families, professionals, rental properties.

office.title: Office Cleaning
office.tagline: A clean workspace is a productive workspace.
office.description: Professional cleaning for offices, co-working spaces, and commercial premises. We offer evening and weekend slots so your business day is never interrupted.
office.note: Ideal for: SMEs, startups, law firms, healthcare clinics.

moving.title: Moving Cleaning
moving.description: A thorough move-in or move-out clean that meets landlord and rental agency standards. We follow a detailed checklist covering every room, including inside appliances and behind fixtures.
includes: Interior of all cupboards and drawers
moving.note: Ideal for: tenants, landlords, real estate agents.

deep.title: Deep Cleaning
deep.tagline: A thorough reset for your space.
deep.description: An intensive one-time clean covering every surface, corner, and hard-to-reach area. Perfect as a first visit before switching to regular maintenance cleaning, or as a seasonal refresh.
includes: Behind and under furniture and appliances
Inside all cabinets, wardrobes, and drawers
Skirting boards, door frames, and vents
deep.note: Ideal for: post-renovation, seasonal clean, first-time customers.
